Routing should be blind to what a models name is anyway, it should just look at the available resources and if it can't climb, then it should climb sideways, to the next highest rated available model, even if that is another version of Opus 4.8.
Then why not name the model? Is it Fable? Then yes we should add it.
The fingerprints should be recomputed in the first blind run of any experiment anyway. So they should be reset after the next live experiment runs.

Models can use up and down, as well as sideways, according to their measured capability and a sane distribution of the available resources, so that no model sits idle when it is still capable of doing useful work.
One of the project's 2 free models does not appear on the capability ladder at all and should be added to it.
The per-experiment seat fingerprint reset should be total, so that each run measures its seats afresh rather than inheriting an earlier experiment's observations.
The decomposition futility guard's loader takes no scope parameter, so it reads prior experiments' capacities from disk while the main path returns nothing.
